Foundations of Computing

Revision for Foundations of Computing: notes on 10 units, 296 practice questions with explanations, 78 flashcards and 73 common traps, plus timed mock papers marked like the real quiz (+1 correct · −0.25 wrong · 0 blank). Free, and it remembers what you get wrong.

What's covered

  1. Computing & the IPO model

    What computing actually is · The IPO model · Knight Capital — the cost of bad computing · Computing in non-tech industries · Why learn to program in the LLM era

  2. Data & the DIKW chain

    Data — the definition · DIKW — Data → Information → Knowledge → Wisdom

  3. Data classification

    1 · By structure: structured / unstructured / semi-structured · 2 · Across time: cross-sectional / panel / time series · 3 · By nature: quantitative / qualitative · 4 · By origin: primary / secondary / metadata

  4. Algorithms

    Definition and origin · The five essential properties

  5. Hardware

    Why hardware matters, and the GPU story · CPU vs GPU · Memory: RAM, ROM, secondary storage · Input and output devices

  6. Software, OS & utilities

    The three layers of software · Operating systems · Utility software · Application software · Interpreter vs compiler · Textbook: Getting Started

  7. Python basics

    Python and Google Colab · Variables and naming rules · Strings · Numbers, type conversion, comments · Live Lecture 4: strings, numbers and errors · Textbook: Getting Started · Textbook: Variables and Simple Data Types

  8. Lists, slicing & tuples

    Creating and accessing lists · Adding and removing — the five methods · Organising: sort, sorted, reverse, len · Looping and indentation errors · range(), numerical lists and comprehensions · Slicing · Copying lists, and tuples · Live Lecture 4: list operations worked through · Textbook: Introducing Lists · Textbook: Working with Lists

  9. Conditional tests & if statements

    Conditional tests: equality and comparisons · Combining tests: and, or, in, not in, Booleans · if, if-else and if-elif-else · Omitting else, and independent ifs · if statements with lists · Textbook: if Statements

  10. Dictionaries & nesting

    Working with dictionaries · A dictionary of similar objects
